html:
The declaration of 26 July 1847 by which the settlers of the American Colonization Society colony made Liberia an independent republic, the first in Africa.

The colony had been founded at Monrovia in 1822 for free Black Americans and freed slaves. Independence was declared partly because Britain would not accept taxes and borders set by a private society. The constitution copied that of the United States, and Joseph Jenkins Roberts became the first president. Britain recognised the new state in 1848; the United States only in 1862. Power stayed with the Americo-Liberians, a small minority, until the coup of 1980.
sum: The declaration of 26 July 1847 by which the settlers of the American Colonization Society colony made Liberia an independent republic, the first in Africa.
